headline: NABU and SAP exposed a scheme to seize 100 thousand tonnes of petroleum products from "Ukrnafta"
summary: Ukraine's NABU and SAP say a scheme aimed to seize 100 thousand tonnes of petroleum products from Ukrnafta. Four participants have been notified of suspicion, including a former supervisory board member.
why: Ukrnafta is Ukraine's state-owned oil and gas producer, so fraud or asset diversion at the company affects energy supply and governance risk.
